data_sources.description: Customer name, tax id (VAT/PAN) and primary address.
data_sources.query:
SELECT p.customer_name AS party_name, p.tax_id AS tax_id, a.address_line1 AS address
FROM `tabCustomer` p
    LEFT JOIN `tabAddress` a ON a.name = p.customer_primary_address
WHERE p.name = %(customer)s

data_sources.description: Opening / closing balance from GL Entry.
data_sources.query:
SELECT
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN gle.posting_date < %(from_date)s
                       OR gle.is_opening = 'Yes'
                      THEN gle.debit - gle.credit END), 0)  AS opening,
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN gle.posting_date <= %(to_date)s
                       OR gle.is_opening = 'Yes'
                      THEN gle.debit - gle.credit END), 0)  AS closing
FROM `tabGL Entry` gle
WHERE gle.is_cancelled = 0
  AND gle.company = %(company)s
  AND gle.party_type = 'Customer'
  AND gle.party = %(customer)s

data_sources.description: Period taxable, VAT and total from Sales Invoice.
data_sources.query:
SELECT
    COALESCE(SUM(inv.base_net_total), 0)          AS taxable,
    COALESCE(SUM(inv.custom_total_vat_amount), 0) AS vat,
    0                                   AS tds,
    COALESCE(SUM(inv.base_grand_total), 0)         AS total
FROM `tabSales Invoice` inv
WHERE inv.docstatus = 1
  AND inv.company = %(company)s
  AND inv.customer = %(customer)s
  AND inv.posting_date BETWEEN %(from_date)s AND %(to_date)s
